about: The install route. probe.py reads it and reports, per stage, which criterion holds and which does not; SKILL.md walks it in order. Every stage is judged from the world (files, binaries, git) each time, so a stopped install resumes by probing again.

criteria.says: the directory is inside a git work tree
the machine is one getarc ships a binary for (macOS arm64, Linux x86_64)
python3 is 3.11+ (tomllib), so the TOML checks below can read config files
`arc` runs and prints a version
the installed arc has every verb this route uses (`arc <verb> --help` succeeds)

stages.title: LLM providers in tars
asks: Which model providers do you have access to (an API key, or a signed-in Claude Code / Codex / agy CLI)?

criteria.says: <tars home>/config.toml exists
it parses as TOML and has at least one [providers.<id>] with a known type
arc itself reads it and lists its provider ids (`arc init` in a throwaway repo — tars refuses an unknown key here)
every env-var credential a provider names is set in this shell, and every CLI provider's executable is on PATH

stages.title: arc init: .arc/config.toml [roles]
asks: Which tars provider reviews (critic) and which fixes (fixer)? The fixer should be a different model family.

criteria.says: .arc/config.toml exists
it has no [providers] section (arc refuses one)
every [roles] value names a provider id in tars, and a critic resolves (critic_l4 / critic / default)
fixer is written out (it never falls back to default)
fixer and critic are different model families
a claude_cli fixer has tools = "default"; a codex_cli fixer has sandbox = "workspace-write"

stages.title: Merge gate: .github/workflows/merge.yml
asks: Will a merge machine land this repo's PRs (merge gate), and if so which checks must pass?

criteria.says: .github/workflows/merge.yml exists
its trigger is workflow_dispatch only, so GitHub never runs it
`arc workflow … --job <job> --list` exits 0 for every job

stages.title: Deploy: [release] + .arc/delivery.toml
asks: Does this repo deploy from a merge machine? If so, which workflow job is the deploy?

criteria.says: [release] in .arc/config.toml names a workflow (and job)
`arc workflow <file> --job <job> --list` exits 0
the deploy workflow declares a concurrency: group
.arc/delivery.toml has exactly one [builds.*] naming the same workflow and job

stages.title: Coding agents: Fixer CLI and bridge hooks
asks: Which coding agent do you use (Claude Code, Codex CLI, agy)? Do you have an arc-bridge server address from an operator?

criteria.says: the fixer provider's agent CLI (claude / codex / agy) is on PATH
~/.arc/client.toml names a board (`web = …`) — only with an operator's bridge server
the agent's settings run `arc bridge hook …`
`arc rot --no-judge` exits 0 here (binary, repo and [review] exclude all read)
the repo has an origin remote (`arc review` pushes to it)
`gh auth status` succeeds (`arc review` opens the PR through gh)
this machine's ~/.arc/machine.toml serves this repo as a tenant, so `arc local-review` / `arc fix` can run here
